verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing documents a Free plan at $0/month with 250 searches per month and says users can "start for free." Cached searches are free and don't count toward the monthly quota, and an interactive playground supports prototyping. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the free plan, and documentation of which engines or features the free tier includes or restricts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype against the API on a free tier or free credits

citations.quote: Start for free, upgrade as you grow
Cached searches are free, and are not counted towards your searches per month.
